name: Butterfly Legends
desc:
🦋 BUTTERFLY KNIFE LEGENDS!

⚔️ Upgrade your butterfly knife and unlock powerful evolutions!
📦 Unlock new cases to open unique butterfly knifes!
🌎 Discover new worlds & locations as you progress!

💥 Perform insane balisong tricks to gain strength!
📈 Train harder, grow faster, dominate the leaderboard!
🏆 Become the ultimate knife master!

⭐️ Don’t forget to LIKE 👍 and FAVORITE ⭐️ the game!

🔥 Join our group for exclusive rewards & future updates!
